item.title: Governors, not Tinubu, are responsible for tackling insecurity in states - Orji Kalu
item.description: Orji Kalu, senator representing Abia north, says Nigerians should stop blaming President Bola Tinubu for the country’s insecurity. Speaking on Thursday in Ekoli Edda, Edda LGA of Ebonyi, during a New Year visit to Stanley Emegha, chairman of the All Progressives Congress (APC) in the state, Kalu urged governors to take responsibility for securing their states. item.title: Explosions rock Caracas as US bombs Venezuela
item.description: Several explosions rocked Caracas early Saturday, with a CNN team reporting that parts of the Venezuelan capital have been cut off from the electricity grid. The first blast was recorded at about 1.50am local time, according to the network. “One was so strong, my window was shaking after it,” Osmary Hernandez, a CNN correspondent, said.
